changes_vs_current: New topic. Scope: people known for paintings. Michelangelo counts (Sistine Chapel). Bob Ross counts. Sculptor-only Donatello, architect Frank Lloyd Wright, photographer Ansel Adams, designer Coco Chanel, Yoko Ono and Paul McCarthy were left out even though they sit on YouGov's 'artists' list. Banksy counts (street painter). Raw average-rank order over the four people sources: da Vinci, Van Gogh, Michelangelo, Picasso, Warhol, Kahlo, Monet, Bob Ross, Rockwell, Rembrandt, Raphael, Pollock, Dali, Banksy, O'Keeffe, Matisse, Kinkade, Gauguin, Renoir, Haring, Hockney, Vermeer, then a four-way tie (Degas, Hopper, Cezanne, Rubens at 28.2, all with 3 sources), broken by YouGov popularity (Degas 36, Hopper 34). Gut-check moves: (1) Bob Ross moved from #8 to #5. He is #3-4 on both YouGov metrics (89% fame, 69% popularity) and #7 on Wikipedia. His only weak spot is being missing from Rascasse's painter list, which looks like a classification issue (he is probably filed as a TV personality), not low interest. (2) Salvador Dalí moved from #13 to #10. He is #9-10 on YouGov and #10 on Wikipedia, and missing from page 1 of Rascasse only. Raphael and Pollock each drop one place to make room. Raphael's Rascasse #7 is probably inflated by the Ninja Turtle. Georgia O'Keeffe (gut #12) stays at #15 because all three sources that list her put her at #13-21. Basquiat, Kusama, Caravaggio, Klimt, Goya and Rivera fell short (avg 29-34): each has a strong Wikipedia rank but no YouGov page was found.
confidence: High for the top 4 (da Vinci, Van Gogh, Michelangelo, Picasso): every source puts them in its top 6. Medium-high for #5-12: they are well separated from the rest, but their order depends on the source. Warhol and Kahlo are much higher on search and Wikipedia than on YouGov popularity, while Rockwell and Rembrandt are the reverse. Medium for #13-19 (Pollock, Banksy, O'Keeffe, Matisse, Kinkade, Gauguin, Renoir). Low for #20-24: Haring and Hockney lean on Wikipedia and Rascasse only, and Vermeer, Degas and Hopper are nearly tied with Cezanne, Rubens and Manet. Near misses: Cezanne, Rubens, Manet, Toulouse-Lautrec, Klimt, Basquiat, Botticelli, Rothko, Kusama, Caravaggio, Bosch, Munch. Caveats: no US open-ended 'favorite painter' poll was found, so YouGov popularity and fame (one panel, two metrics) carry much of the weight. Rascasse is a noisy search-based list (it contains non-painters, and Raphael is confused with the Ninja Turtle).
